extraction.Name: Elvira Pike
extraction.Recorded patent: Recorded in Duchesne County October 7, 1920 by the patentee.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgage dated September 7, 1927 for $400.00 to Louise McLean; land has since been sold to R.M. Michie for $40.00 per acre, plus $500.00 for the improvements.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Not sold, for debt or taxes.
extraction.Occupation/Income: teacher at Cortez, Colo., off the reservation; self-supporting
extraction.NOTES: Mental and physical condition excellent; unmarried and so far as can be determined has no one dependent on her for support; was not defrauded of her property; the price received was a good consideration, and not in settlement of an old debt; fee patent delivered September 8, 1920 by mail and was receipted for; land description: Lot 4, Sec. 19, T. 1 S., R. 7 W., 30.81 acres; document dated 8-27-29.
